verdict.rationale: Swell supports event-driven automation via webhooks that subscribe to model events and trigger outgoing calls, plus lifecycle events generated on custom models — this covers 'trigger actions on events' but is developer/webhook-configuration based rather than a declarative rules engine an AI-native user could define at runtime. missing for 10: a rules/condition builder UI or API for defining custom trigger logic, evidence of AI-driven or natural-language rule authoring, and independent confirmation of webhook reliability in production.
